read.en: Coherent rose 6.5% on Oct 27 to $235.79, trading between $222.25 and $236.90 and closing near the high. It is above the falling 5-day ($222.4) and 10-day ($232.3), and below the falling 30-day ($282.1) and 100-day ($309.7) averages and the rising 200-day ($295.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($254.53), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: Coherent 10月27日上涨 6.5%，收于 $235.79，盘中区间 $222.25–236.90，收在高点附近。股价位于下行的 5 日（$222.4）和 10 日均线（$232.3）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$282.1）和 100 日均线（$309.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$295.9）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$254.53），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The rebound cleared $221.6–225.7 and $231.6–232.3 (Oct 16 and 19 lows, 10-day), now support. Resistance is $236.9 (Oct 27 high), then $243.6 (Oct 21 high) and $252.3–254.5 (Oct 15 high, SAR). Support is $231.6–232.3, then $222.3–222.4 (Oct 27 low, 5-day) and $208.9 (Oct 26 low). A close above $236.9 would target $243.6; a close below $231.6 would reopen $222.

s.en: 10-day average $232.3; Oct 16 and Oct 19 lows ($231.6–231.8), cleared
